family.description: Protocol-v3 confirmation of jit:26465e6c. Question: how does gf2's fused AVX2 AND-popcount kernel (and_popcnt_fn, which BitMatrix::matvec_simd calls per row) compare with a single-pass portable control and with the two-pass public gf2-core route a consumer takes today (copy into a temporary, kernels::ops::and_inplace, kernels::ops::popcount) at a small, an L2-resident and a streaming size? The fused kernel is the baseline of every cell, so a speedup below 1 means the fused kernel is faster. Two-pass cells are whole-consumer: the temporary buffer and the extra pass lie inside every timed call. Neither pinned external library exposes a fused AND or XOR reduction, so no external arm exists. Every arm is single-threaded, so every cell is single-core. The protocol-v1 confirmation of this question was frozen but never run. The frozen ledger holds 0 earlier non-exploratory reservation(s) spending 0 comparisons, so this confirmation is attempt 1 with cumulative m = 6: the corrected per-comparison alpha 0.05/(1*2)/6 = 0.004167 leaves 20.83 expected bootstrap draws per tail, meeting the 20 P-20 requires; P-20's endpoint-stability check still applies cell by cell.

effect.rationale: Unused: every cell is comparator-gap and decides against the material-gap threshold.
effect.equivalence_rationale: An alternative within 5% of the fused kernel is not a materially different implementation for a consumer of these leaf kernels, so an interval whose lower bound clears 1/margin records not-worse rather than a gap. The consumer-benefit value 1.05 does not strictly exceed one plus the pilot resolution 0.05, so the operative equivalence margin is 1.06.
effect.material_gap_rationale: An alternative must run at least 10% faster than the fused kernel before replacing the fused kernel, or moving a dispatch threshold toward the alternative, could repay its maintenance and dependency cost for a consumer; smaller gaps leave the established route in place.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: A baseline survey: it authorizes no production change. Adoption belongs to the optimization issue that consumes this baseline, with its own before/after evidence.
